menu:41766520:1.source_cn: 你……你是圣石镇的魔法师大人吧！

say:1:1060902001:1.text: We meet again! What a coincidence!
say:1:1060902001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我们又见面了！太巧了！
say:1:1060902001:1.male: We meet again! What a coincidence!
say:1:1060902001:1.female: We meet again! What a coincidence!

say:2:1060902002:1.text: Remember me? We met right before the Mithril Consortium in Holistone, and you helped me pack.
say:2:1060902002:1.source_cn: 你还记得我吗？圣石镇的秘银商会前面，我们见过面的，你还...

choice_prompt:3:1060902002.text: Remember me? We met right before the Mithril Consortium in Holistone, and you helped me pack.
choice_prompt:3:1060902002.source_cn: 你还记得我吗？圣石镇的秘银商会前面，我们见过面的，你还帮我整理了背包。

say:4:1060902003:1.text: I'm here on business, of course!

say:5:1060902004:1.text: I took your advice and brought in a batch of well-crafted goods. I'm guessing the Wilders barely encounter items from the Lightbearer Empire, so these should sell well here.
say:5:1060902004:1.source_cn: 我听了你的建议，进了一批做工精良的商品，想着绿裔很少见...

say:6:1060902005:1.text: However, I can't get in the forest, and even worse, I haven't seen many Wilders around. So, I can only set up a roadside stand.
say:6:1060902005:1.source_cn: 不过，呃……丛林现在进不去，我也没见到几个绿裔，只能在...

say:7:1060902006:1.text: But the people here are all refugees, so I'm getting ready to pack my bags and go check out other places.
say:7:1060902006:1.source_cn: 但这里的人都是难民，我进的这批货价格有点高，他们想买也...

say:8:1060902007:1.text: But... well... my stuff is all over the place again.
say:8:1060902007:1.source_cn: 只不过……嘿、嘿嘿……这些东西我又装不回去了。

choice_prompt:9:1060902007.text: But... well... my stuff is all over the place again.
choice_prompt:9:1060902007.source_cn: 只不过……嘿、嘿嘿……这些东西我又装不回去了。

say:10:1060902008:1.source_cn: 拜托你了，魔法师大人，帮帮忙吧……

say:12:1060902009:1.text: Don't go, Magister! Please help me!
say:12:1060902009:1.source_cn: 别、别走呀，魔法师大人！拜托你了，帮帮忙吧！
say:12:1060902009:1.male: Don't go, Magister! Please help me!
say:12:1060902009:1.female: Don't go, Magister! Please help me!

say:1:1060903001:1.text: Everything is all packed up! Thank you so much, Magister!
say:1:1060903001:1.source_cn: 全都装回去了！太感谢你了，魔法师大人！
say:1:1060903001:1.male: Everything is all packed up! Thank you so much, Magister!
say:1:1060903001:1.female: Everything is all packed up! Thank you so much, Magister!

say:2:1060903002:1.text: Now I can finally set off! I've heard that the Dark Forest and the Vaduso Mountains are full of treasures. I need to go take a look myself.
say:2:1060903002:1.source_cn: 这下终于可以启程了，我早就听说薄暮丛林和瓦度索山脉有很...

say:3:1060903003:1.text: If I'm able to find a treasure or two, I'll definitely be able to join the Mithril Consortium.
say:3:1060903003:1.source_cn: 要是能找到一两件宝物，我肯定就能加入秘银商会了……！

choice_prompt:4:1060903003.text: If I'm able to find a treasure or two, I'll definitely be able to join the Mithril Consortium.
choice_prompt:4:1060903003.source_cn: 要是能找到一两件宝物，我肯定就能加入秘银商会了……！

say:5:1060903004:1.text: This is going to be a problem... Should I take the long way?
say:5:1060903004:1.source_cn: 这、这倒是个棘手的问题……丛林进不去，只能绕路了吧？

say:6:1060903005:1.text: But there should be more than one entrance to get into the forest. If I walk around the edges, I could find another way in! I also won't get lost this time.
say:6:1060903005:1.source_cn: 不过，丛林应该不止一个入口，沿着丛林边缘多转两圈，肯定...

say:7:1060903006:1.text: Thanks for everything, Magister! I'll be taking my leave now. Hopefully, we will meet again!
say:7:1060903006:1.source_cn: 多谢你的提醒，魔法师大人！我先出发了，有机会再见！
say:7:1060903006:1.male: Thanks for everything, Magister! I'll be taking my leave now. Hopefully, we will meet again!
say:7:1060903006:1.female: Thanks for everything, Magister! I'll be taking my leave now. Hopefully, we will meet again!

choice:4:0:1.text: How are you planning to get in?
